topic: Your 401k's expense ratio, even at 1%, can quietly eat close to a third of your lifetime returns
title: How a 1% Fee Can Cost You 28% of Your Retirement
description:
That small 1% fee in your 401(k) isn't small at all. Over a lifetime, it can consume over a quarter of your potential returns. Here's how the math actually works.

#401k #investing #retirement #personalfinance #expenseratio
